component.name: krisCC
component.summary: Personal Kirigami control center for KrisOS and Fedora bootc

description.p: krisCC provides persistent software management, Flatpak applications, Podman containers, bootc deployments, practical maintenance tools, diagnostics, recovery and local configuration/home backups without duplicating Plasma System Settings.
Kirigami UI, RPM and Flatpak management, Podman container tools, maintenance and personal backup snapshots.
